arbitration_policy.summary: Accept defender context as operationally valid, but prioritize prosecutor worst-case risk for AI coding because regression amplification is the optimization target.

ai_coding_strategy: Prioritize boundary-contract hardening before feature work.
Prefer fail-loud degraded-mode outcomes over silent fallback success.
Converge duplicate service facades to reduce drift surface.

actionable_slops.title: Missing explicit error taxonomy across auth/session/data/privacy boundaries
guidance_for_ai_coding_prioritization: Define a discriminated DomainError union and require boundary mappers at provider/service/route edges.
Reject generic catch-all errors in touched files unless mapped to a stable domain code.
Gate merges on tests that assert stable error translation across at least one auth and one data path.

actionable_slops.title: Silent-failure risk from multi-layer fallback chains (crypto + cache + offline)
guidance_for_ai_coding_prioritization: Replace boolean fallback outcomes with explicit mode/result payloads (normal, degraded, stale, failed).
Propagate degraded mode to UI and telemetry, never swallow it as success.
Add regression tests for stale-read and crypto-unavailable scenarios.

actionable_slops.title: Inconsistent error propagation between client provider, service facades, and API routes
guidance_for_ai_coding_prioritization: Pick one propagation contract per boundary family (Result-or-throw) and codify it.
Block mixed nullable-plus-throw patterns in modified code paths.
Add contract tests ensuring same backend failure yields equivalent user-facing semantics.

actionable_slops.title: Import/export pipeline likely lacks partial-failure semantics
guidance_for_ai_coding_prioritization: Introduce an import report contract with created, updated, skipped, failed, and retryable counts.
Make retries idempotent and resumable with operation markers.
Require UX to surface partial success instead of binary success.

actionable_slops.title: Unused dual-service architecture (`simple` vs `cached`) increases error drift
guidance_for_ai_coding_prioritization: Select one production facade as canonical and route all new AI edits through it.
If both must exist temporarily, enforce a shared contract test suite across both facades.
Tag the non-canonical facade as migration-only and prevent net-new behavior there.

actionable_slops.title: Auth refresh/validation loop lacks explicit retry budget and terminal states
guidance_for_ai_coding_prioritization: Define explicit auth state machine terminals (authenticated, backoff, reauth-required, force-logout).
Set retry budgets and jittered backoff; fail closed when budget is exhausted.
Add tests for network flap loops and concurrent refresh races.

actionable_slops.title: Cache subsystem breadth can mask cache-write/cache-invalidate failures
guidance_for_ai_coding_prioritization: Promote cache outcomes to first-class typed results (applied, missed, failed).
Emit cache invalidation diagnostics in development and CI tests.
Prevent AI-generated mutations from skipping invalidation checks.

actionable_slops.title: SSR mock cache adapters risk diverging failure semantics from browser runtime
guidance_for_ai_coding_prioritization: Centralize a single SSR adapter and mirror browser degraded/error semantics.
Run parity tests that assert SSR and browser adapters classify failure modes equivalently.
Avoid no-op success returns in SSR for operations that can fail in browser runtime.

actionable_slops.title: "Class + singleton + bound exports" obscures ownership of throw/catch boundaries
guidance_for_ai_coding_prioritization: Consolidate to one invocation/export pattern per service module.
Keep throw/catch normalization at explicit boundary functions.
Require stack-preserving rethrow wrappers where mapping is necessary.

actionable_slops.title: Placeholder options/no-op API paths can imply successful handling when none occurred
guidance_for_ai_coding_prioritization: Delete no-op branches when possible; otherwise emit runtime warning and explicit unsupported result.
Prevent silent accept-and-ignore options in public APIs.
Add tests that fail when unsupported options appear to succeed.

actionable_slops.title: Cache invalidation rule set includes non-active operations, diluting failure signal clarity
guidance_for_ai_coding_prioritization: Prune speculative invalidation rules not exercised by active mutations.
Require each rule to have a traceable runtime owner or test.
Keep rule set minimal to preserve debugging signal quality.
